title: U2 Performs Live, Talks New Album 'Carnaval de Luz' on SiriusXM
summary: Hear U2 perform new music and discuss their latest album during an exclusive SiriusXM Front Row event.
body_markdown:
[U2](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/u2) is celebrating the release of their new album, *Carnaval de Luz* , with an exclusive SiriusXM Front Row interview and intimate live performance, airing Friday, November 13 at 6pm ET on[U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/u2x-radio) .


[U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32) U2’s songs, stories & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogU2FrontRowU2XRadio)


The special event will be recorded in front of a live audience of SiriusXM subscribers at SiriusXM’s Los Angeles studios on November 11 and will feature an in-depth conversation with Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton, and Larry Mullen Jr. about their new music and the creative process behind the album.


The band will also answer questions from the studio audience and perform a selection of songs, including new music from *Carnaval de Luz* , which arrives November 13.


### **How to Listen to the U2 Front Row**


Hear the exclusive U2 Front Row interview and performance on U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32) and afterward on the SiriusXM app.


**Broadcast Date:** Friday, November 13, 2026
**Time:** 6pm ET
**Channel:** U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32)
**On Demand:** Available afterward on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogU2FrontRowU2XRadio)


### **Win Tickets to the U2 Front Row**


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to attend the exclusive U2 Front Row event on Wednesday, November 11, at SiriusXM’s Los Angeles studios.


[Enter for a chance to attend U2’s SiriusXM Front Row.](https://www.siriusxm.com/u2frontrowlapr)


### **About U2’s New Album, *Carnaval de Luz***


U2’s new album, *Carnaval de Luz* , arrives Friday, November 13, featuring 12 tracks, including “Go (Carnaval de Luz),” “La Reina,” “Street of Dreams,” and “Torn,” featuring Dolly Parton.


### **Get U2’s Limited-Edition ‘Carnaval de Luz’ Vinyl**


In partnership with SiriusXM, U2 is releasing an[exclusive limited-edition pressing of Carnaval de Luz on Deep Ocean Marble Vinyl](https://interscope.com/products/carnaval-de-luz-u2-x-siriusxm-limited-edition-deep-ocean-marble-vinyl) . Priced at $50.99, the collectible edition features all 12 tracks on heavyweight 180-gram vinyl, housed in a gatefold sleeve with full-color artwork and a gloss finish.


The special release also includes a 16-page booklet featuring lyrics, photography, and exclusive album imagery, along with a printed inner sleeve and custom vinyl labels.


The limited-edition vinyl ships November 13, with purchases limited to four copies per customer.
